id: title:Piccirello:always enforce the app policy on signed in and login pages

review.posthog_relevance: Changes CSP enforcement behavior for Cloud, Hobby, and Self-hosted deployments, potentially preventing self-hosted users from accidentally breaking pages with enforced CSP while Cloud and Hobby users receive protection.
review.reason: The implementation chunk P1.F2.H5 demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement: it establishes the conditional CSP enforcement behavior across different deployment tiers (Cloud, Hobby, Self-hosted) and signed-out page handling. This is not merely documentation or a narrow maintenance change; it implements the actual enforcement and reporting logic. However, the score
review.uncertainty: The score is assigned based on the implementation chunk P1.F2.H5, but the test chunk P1.F3.H9 and P1.F3.H10 do not demonstrate the actual behavior, only the expected assertions. This could potentially raise the score to 3 if the tests were shown to demonstrate the actual behavior, but since they are not, the score remains at 2.
